genes.context: Reference 828 explicitly mentions "SGLT2 inhibitors: mechanisms of cardiovascular benefit beyond glycaemic control," and subsequent references (829, 830, 832) discuss canagliflozin, dapagliflozin and empagliflozin cardiovascular outcomes in type 2 diabetes and heart failure.

Reference 825 describes "Angiotensin receptor–neprilysin inhibition in acute myocardial infarction," indicating neprilysin (encoded by MME) as the molecular target discussed in the context of myocardial infarction and related cardiovascular disease.
